import socket, ssl, json
from urllib.parse import urlparse

def run(url, body="", headers=None, method="POST", timeout=15, **kwargs):
    p = urlparse(url)
    host = p.hostname
    port = p.port or (443 if p.scheme == "https" else 80)
    path = p.path or "/"
    if p.query:
        path += "?" + p.query
    hdrs = dict(headers or {})
    hdrs.setdefault("Host", host)
    hdrs.setdefault("Connection", "close")
    payload = body.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(body, str) else json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
    if payload and "Content-Length" not in {k.title() for k in hdrs}:
        hdrs["Content-Length"] = str(len(payload))
    req = f"{method} {path} HTTP/1.1\r\n"
    for k, v in hdrs.items():
        req += f"{k}: {v}\r\n"
    req += "\r\n"
    raw = req.encode("utf-8") + payload
    s = socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=timeout)
    try:
        if p.scheme == "https":
            ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
            ctx.check_hostname = False
            ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
            s = ctx.wrap_socket(s, server_hostname=host)
        s.sendall(raw)
        chunks = []
        total = 0
        while True:
            b = s.recv(65536)
            if not b:
                break
            chunks.append(b)
            total += len(b)
            if total > 200000:
                break
    finally:
        try:
            s.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
    data = b"".join(chunks)
    head, _, bodyb = data.partition(b"\r\n\r\n")
    # handle chunked transfer encoding
    if b"transfer-encoding: chunked" in head.lower():
        out = []
        rest = bodyb
        while rest:
            line, _, rest = rest.partition(b"\r\n")
            try:
                n = int(line.split(b";")[0], 16)
            except Exception:
                break
            if n == 0:
                break
            out.append(rest[:n])
            rest = rest[n+2:]
        bodyb = b"".join(out)
    return f"HTTP {head.decode('utf-8', 'replace')}\n\nBODY({len(bodyb)}b):\n{bodyb.decode('utf-8', 'replace')[:12000]}"
